meta.title: financ
meta.description: Compare and project financial sources over time.

projectList.heading: Projects
projectList.subtitle: Select a project to continue working.

deleteDialog.title: Delete project?
deleteDialog.body: This will permanently delete {name} and all of its locally stored data. This action cannot be undone.

renameDialog.title: Rename project
renameDialog.body: Enter a new name for this project.

importDialog.collisionBody: A project named {existingName} already exists locally. Overwrite it with the imported project ({incomingName})? This can't be undone.
importDialog.notAProjectFile: That file doesn't look like a project export.

notFound.title: Project not found
notFound.body: This project does not exist in local storage.

reportDialog.title: Export report
reportDialog.description: Choose what to include and a file name for the PDF.
reportDialog.includeSourceSummaries: Include per-source summary (with a small chart for each source)

timedValues.label: Time Series
timedValues.description: Import from a PDF or enter values by hand, like a payment schedule.

indexSeries.label: Index Series
indexSeries.description: Import a researched index (e.g. inflation) from a PDF, to correct other items in this source.

compoundIndex.label: Compound Index
compoundIndex.description: A single rate that compounds over a repeating schedule.

simpleIndex.label: Simple Index
simpleIndex.description: A single non-compounding rate or percentage applied on a schedule.

fixedValue.label: Fixed Value
fixedValue.description: A constant value applied on a schedule.

picker.title: Add item
picker.description: Choose what kind of data you want to add to this source.

emptySource.title: Empty source
emptySource.description: Create the source now and add items later.

timedValuesMethod.title: Add Time Series
timedValuesMethod.description: How do you want to enter the data?

importFromPdf.title: Import from PDF
importFromPdf.description: Pick columns from a parsed PDF table.

enterManually.title: Enter manually
enterManually.description: Type in each date and value by hand.

periodDirection.futureHint: Raw values grow forward to the end of the schedule below.
periodDirection.pastHint: Raw values discount back to the start of the schedule below — what they're worth on the first day.

readingDirection.futureHint: Raw values grow forward to the index's most recent reading — what they're worth today.
readingDirection.pastHint: Raw values discount back to the index's earliest reading — what they were worth on day one.

table.description: Enter each date and value by hand. A row needs both to count.
table.rowsUsable: {usable} of {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} usable.

manual.description: Choose the value, frequency, and when the schedule applies.

frequencyAnchor.weeks: Anchored by the weekday of the reference date.
frequencyAnchor.months: Anchored by the day of the month of the reference date.
frequencyAnchor.years: Anchored by the month and day of the reference date.

manual.applyCount: X times starting on a reference date
manual.applyRange: On this interval over a date range
manual.applyEntire: On this interval for the entire time
manual.referenceDateHint: The relevant day is taken from this date: weekday for weeks, day-of-month for months, or month/day for years.

indexSeriesDirection.title: Add Index Series
indexSeriesDirection.description: Choose which end of the imported data raw values settle toward. You'll pick the PDF table next.

addItemDialog.dateRefUnresolved: (no longer resolves — pick a date or uncheck)
addItemDialog.dateRefNoData: (no dated items in this source yet)

pdfImportDialog.title: Import PDF
pdfImportDialog.description: Select the columns you want to use from the imported tables. Each table needs exactly one date column and at least one number column selected.
pdfImportDialog.uploadValidationFailed: None of the selected columns produced usable data. Check that you selected one date column and at least one numeric value column per table, and that those columns aren't empty in the preview above.
pdfImportDialog.selectionSummary: {datasets, plural, one {# dataset} other {# datasets}} selected · {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}} selected
pdfImportDialog.pagesTablesSummary: {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} · {tables, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}}
pdfImportDialog.blankHidden: {count, plural, one {# blank column hidden} other {# blank columns hidden}}
pdfImportDialog.continuesFromPage: Continues from the table on page {page} — join columns

deleteItemDialog.title: Delete item?
deleteItemDialog.body: This will remove this {type} item from {sourceName}. This action cannot be undone.

deleteSourceDialog.title: Delete source?
deleteSourceDialog.body: This will permanently delete {name} and all {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in it. This action cannot be undone.

columns.rawTitle: Sum of raw values, ignoring any simple/compound-index correction
columns.comparedRawTitle: Raw total compared to the lowest Raw among sources
columns.correctionTitle: VAM minus Raw — the net effect of index correction
